job.name: licensescan
job.script:
#!/bin/bash echo "Scanning for license compliance issues..."
if [ -z "$REPO_ROOT" ]; then echo "ERROR: REPO_ROOT environment variable is not set." exit 1 fi
if [ ! -d "$REPO_ROOT" ]; then echo "ERROR: REPO_ROOT is not a valid directory." exit 1 fi
REPO_ROOT=$(realpath "$REPO_ROOT") echo "Starting license compliance scan in $REPO_ROOT"
RESULTS_FILE=$(mktemp) LICENSE_FOUND=false GPL_FOUND=false
LICENSE_FILES=( "LICENSE" "LICENSE.md" "LICENSE.txt" "COPYING" "COPYING.md" "COPYING.txt" )
scan_for_licenses() { echo "Looking for license files..."
for pattern in "${LICENSE_FILES[@]}"; do if [ -f "$REPO_ROOT/$pattern" ]; then LICENSE_FOUND=true echo "License file found: $REPO_ROOT/$pattern" | tee -a "$RESULTS_FILE"
# Directly check for GPL in this file if grep -i -q -E "(GNU General Public License|GPL|GNU GPL|LGPL|AGPL)" "$REPO_ROOT/$pattern"; then GPL_FOUND=true echo "GPL-family license detected in $pattern" | tee -a "$RESULTS_FILE" fi fi done
if compgen -G "$REPO_ROOT/LICENSE-*" ; then LICENSE_FOUND=true echo "License file with pattern LICENSE-* found" | tee -a "$RESULTS_FILE"
if grep -i -q -E "(GNU General Public License|GPL|GNU GPL|LGPL|AGPL)" "$REPO_ROOT"/LICENSE-*; then GPL_FOUND=true echo "GPL-family license detected in LICENSE-* file" | tee -a "$RESULTS_FILE" fi fi
if compgen -G "$REPO_ROOT/COPYING-*" ; then LICENSE_FOUND=true echo "License file with pattern COPYING-* found" | tee -a "$RESULTS_FILE"
if grep -i -q -E "(GNU General Public License|GPL|GNU GPL|LGPL|AGPL)" "$REPO_ROOT"/COPYING-*; then GPL_FOUND=true echo "GPL-family license detected in COPYING-* file" | tee -a "$RESULTS_FILE" fi fi }
scan_for_licenses
if [ "$GPL_FOUND" = true ]; then echo "LICENSE COMPLIANCE ERROR: GPL or GPL-adjacent license detected" echo "This project uses a GPL-family license which is not allowed." echo "Please use a different license such as MIT, BSD, or Apache 2.0." echo "reject" | tee /pr-status/status exit 1 fi
if [ "$LICENSE_FOUND" = false ]; then echo "LICENSE COMPLIANCE ERROR: No license file found" echo "Please add a license file to the repository." echo "reject" | tee /pr-status/status exit 1 fi
echo "LICENSE COMPLIANCE SUCCESS: No GPL-family license detected"
